C0_mi_selection.issue: MI feature selection in run_phase6.py was performed on the full dataset (before train/test split), introducing minor test-set leakage.

C1_reconstruction_canary.corrected_label: Gradient inversion from fresh single-step gradient at global model (optimistic attacker scenario; batch sizes 1, 4, 16)
C1_reconstruction_canary.corrected_explanation: Phase 6 recon_single computes the gradient of the loss at the global model w for each batch, clips and noises it, then reconstructs x. This models a threat where the attacker has direct access to the clipped gradient — an optimistic scenario. The actual FedAvg coordinator observes model deltas (w_local - w_global after 5 local epochs), for which the single-gradient inversion formula gives cosine -0.538. Single-step analytic canary confirms cosine = 1.000 for direct gradient access. The Phase 6 mixed-batch result (cosine 0.534) reflects batch-size averaging: batch=1 gives near-exact recovery; batch=4,16 dilute the signal.
C1_reconstruction_canary.key_finding: cosine NEGATIVE for multi-step delta inversion, confirming the approximation breaks down. Phase 6 measured fresh-gradient inversion (optimistic attacker), NOT model-delta inversion (realistic coordinator threat).
C1_reconstruction_canary.implication: Phase 6 leakage estimates are conservative — they reflect an optimistic attacker with direct gradient access, which overstates leakage risk relative to the actual model-delta observable.

fallback_label.note: Excluded from all Krum summaries; retained as diagnostic rows only.

C3_auroc_degradation.previous_error: Stated sign_flip -0.065 as worst; label_flip -0.123 is worst
C3_auroc_degradation.corrected: Worst unprotected FedAvg AUROC degradation (eICU, f=3): -0.123 (label_flip). Sign-flip: -0.065. With coordinate-median defense, worst degradation reduces to approximately -0.021. Small degradation is consistent with evaluated model (LR), aggregation weights, clipping, and attack configuration at f/K=37.5%; it is not definitively attributed to convexity or honest majority alone.

C4_arithmetic.corrected_sentence: At alpha=0.01, reconstruction cosine similarity decreased by 13.0% relative (0.534 to 0.464) and feature-sign recovery decreased by 12.4 percentage points (80.3% to 67.9%; 15.4% relative), while AUROC decreased by 0.1 percentage points.
C4_arithmetic.mia_statement: MIA AUROC was 0.496 (eICU; 95% CI [0.496, 0.498]) and 0.507 (Cimas; 95% CI [0.506, 0.507]). Point estimates are near 0.5; confidence intervals are narrow given N=5 seeds. No substantial membership-inference advantage was detected under the evaluated attack.
